name: One Mother, Many Mother Tongues | Imagining the Mother in Art by Prof. Naman P. Ahuja
description:
One Mother, Many Mother Tongues

How have images of the mother and child travelled across cultures, centuries and artistic traditions?

Join Prof. Naman P. Ahuja, Curator, Professor of Art History at JNU and General Editor, Marg, for a keynote exploring the enduring motif of the mother and child, from the Saptamatrika and Devi to the Madonna and Mater Matuta, and the ideas that connect these diverse visual traditions.

The address will also explore the curatorial concerns behind One Mother, Many Mother Tongues.

21 August 2026, Friday | 5:30 PM
At the National Gallery of Modern Art, Bengaluru

name: Bengaluru Starter Pack: A Trivia Game Show with Tasty Trivia
description:
The Bengaluru Starter Pack — now a game show

This edition is an ode to Bengaluru — its hills and lakes, gardens and grids, architecture and evolution. Expect a mix of questions exploring how the city was planned and shaped, from its early contours and colonial designs to modern neighbourhoods, public art, and everyday quirks that define “Namma Bengaluru.”

Here’s what’s on the menu 👇

🤝 Welcoming vibe — friendly, engaging, and beginner-friendly.

🇮🇳 India-themed set — food, culture, films, people, business & more.

🧩 Work-outable questions — designed to be solved with thinking, not rote recall.

🧃 Welcome Drinks (Prelims): fun warm-up round (10–12 Qs, ~30–45 mins).

🍛 Appraiser: fast-paced face-offs & eliminations.

🍲 Main Course: top teams battle it out on a Jeopardy-style grid.

🙌 Audience play-along: submit guesses live & win prizes too.

🏆 Goodies galore: for both audiences & winners

Who is Tasty Trivia?

Tasty Trivia is co-curated by Susovan and Saloni, driven by a shared love for curiosity. A multi-city, community-driven series, it has travelled across 5 cities and runs monthly in Bangalore — offering fun, beginner-friendly trivia events that make knowledge social, engaging, and full of surprises.

name: Sugar & Swirls: A Hands-On Mini Apple Pie Workshop
description:
A slow baking session centred around warm, spiced apple pies made from scratch.

Work through a buttery pastry dough, prepare a gently spiced apple filling, and assemble individual mini pies by hand. The session focuses on simple techniques that shape texture and flavour, from getting the dough just right to achieving a golden, crisp bake.

Each pie is small, personal and thoughtfully put together, making the process as satisfying as the final result.

An easy, hands-on afternoon of baking, working with seasonal fruit and leaving with a batch of freshly baked mini apple pies.

name: The Crucified Lovers - Japanese Film Screening in Whitefield
description:
The Crucified Lovers(1954)

Alternative Title : A Story from Chikamatsu

By Kenji Mizoguchi / 102 mins / Japanese with Eng subs

Based on a classic of eighteenth-century Japanese drama, the film traces the injustices that befall a Kyoto scroll maker’s wife and his apprentice after each is unfairly accused of wrongdoing. Bound by fate in an illicit, star-crossed romance, they go on the run in search of refuge from the punishment prescribed them: death.

name: Manual 3.0
description:
MANUAL 3.0

What does it look like when a craft refuses to disappear?

Manual is our ongoing analog culture revival at The Commons - a space to slow down, rediscover fading crafts, and put them back into people’s hands.

Manual 3.0 is about enamel painting. Meet Surabhi, an artist from Kannur who has spent years hand-painting the bold, brush-lettered signage that once covered shopfronts, walls and banners - before flex boards took over. Think Nirma ads, toothpaste walls and playful beedi art. No stencils. No digital tools. Just muscle memory and a steady hand.

Come experience an enamel painting workshop and explore his living gallery at The Commons.

“Some crafts don't need saving. They just need a room to keep living in.”

What's the lineup?
12:00pm – Doors open with vinyl, food & drinks
12:30pm – Meet the artist
1:00pm – Explore the gallery
1:30–3:30pm – Hands-on enamel painting workshop

Come with curiosity. We’ll take care of the rest.

Ajji House by Subko, Bangalore | August 30th | 12pm onwards

Can’t make the workshop? The gallery stays live until September 5th.
